messages.text: I’m checking whether `vite preview` serves the built Start app correctly on a separate port. If it binds, I’ll point Playwright at preview instead of dev.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$p = Start-Process -FilePath .'"\\node_modules\\.bin\\vite.cmd -ArgumentList @('preview','--configLoader','native','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','3010') -WorkingDirectory 'T:\\' -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; Write-Output \"PID="'$($p.Id)"; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3010 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess'
